title: Event Authority Spine Classification v1
principle: One store per authority tier. Append-only domain events are authoritative. Projections, caches, and analytical snapshots are derived and disposable. No store may claim 'canonical' unless its domain is explicitly declared.

classification.canonical_claim: Authoritative runtime events for cross-session coordination lifecycle. The steward is the sole coordination writer.
Authoritative validated evidence output. JSON shard files + manifest.jsonl remain source-of-truth for governance decisions.
Not cryptographically signed. Append-only guarantees are best-effort local (flush + fsync per append).
Advisory only — Ralph recommends, steward disposes. Ralph events are recommendation history until explicitly promoted.
Advisory only. Lane events track worktree lifecycle but do not own authoritative task claims (CoordinationStore owns those).
Authoritative append-only agent observation ledger. 14 report kinds. Reports are raw observations; canonical findings ledger is separate.
Canonical event stream for a single session's telemetry. Not the canonical event stream for cross-session lifecycle (CoordinationStore owns that).
Pending explicit disposition as either projection bus (migrated to CoordinationStore + Telemetry) or retired.

domain: generic storage backend for JSONL content-light events
classification.canonical_claim: Protocol for reading/writing JSONL. compact() is DEPRECATED for authoritative event streams — use only for disposable analytical caches.
Durable, content-light audit events and result artifacts for the Desktop Intent API.

competing_claims_corrected.old_claim: observability.jsonl is the canonical event stream for a session.
competing_claims_corrected.corrected_claim: observability.jsonl is the canonical event stream for a single session's telemetry observations. Cross-session lifecycle events are authoritative in CoordinationStore.
.events/ (Event Fabric) was a proposed canonical event stream. It is now classified as temporary compatibility pending disposition.

competing_claims_corrected.old_claim: observability.jsonl is the canonical event stream (evidence-retained fields).
competing_claims_corrected.corrected_claim: observability.jsonl is the per-session telemetry stream. Coordination events are the cross-session authoritative runtime events.

competing_claims_corrected.old_claim: Every coordination primitive emits a canonical event row into the session's observability.jsonl stream.
competing_claims_corrected.corrected_claim: Every coordination primitive emits an authoritative event row into CoordinationStore's events.jsonl. The session's observability.jsonl captures telemetry observations, not coordination events.

authority_hierarchy.name: Authoritative Domain Events
authority_hierarchy.rule: Append-only. Never compacted. Source of truth for derived current-state projections. Workers must not write to this tier.

authority_hierarchy.name: Authoritative Evidence Receipts
authority_hierarchy.rule: Append-only. Validated outputs with content-light payloads and SHA256 references. Referenced by domain events, not embedded in them.

authority_hierarchy.name: Audit & Observation Appendices
authority_hierarchy.rule: Append-only. Provide provenance and context. May reference tier 1/2 events. Not themselves lifecycle authority.

authority_hierarchy.name: Telemetry Observations
authority_hierarchy.rule: Append-only per session. Product analytics and diagnostic source. May be retained with time-limited GC. Not domain event authority.

authority_hierarchy.name: Advisory & Recommendation History
authority_hierarchy.rule: Append-only. Records recommendations. May be promoted to tier 3+ if recommendations become authorized actions.

authority_hierarchy.name: Disposable Analytical Caches & Projections
authority_hierarchy.rule: May be compacted, truncated, or rebuilt from authoritative stores. Never claim canonical or authoritative status.

deprecation_notices.action: DeprecationWarning emitted on call. Use only for disposable analytical caches.
Reclassified as temporary compatibility. CoordinationStore is authoritative for runtime lifecycle.
Clarified as per-session telemetry only. CoordinationStore is cross-session authority.
